title: Scroll-linked shaders
blurb: Blocks of a page burn in, unroll and melt as you scroll, and blur by the scroll speed. View timelines, a scroll-state() query and a timeline trigger set the shader inputs. The page has no scroll listener.
question: Can scroll-driven animations, scroll-state() queries and timeline triggers drive the shader that draws live DOM, with no scroll listener in the page?
result: Yes. All three set registered custom properties on elements inside a canvas, and scroll speed can be derived in CSS from two properties.
